# AML Detection Standard Update and Regulatory Review

This document highlights the critical need for an urgent review and update of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection standards. This update is essential for aligning with Strategy 2026 and incorporating recent regulatory changes.

## Key Action Items:

*   Review the current AML detection standard update.
*   Update the AML detection protocols for Strategy 2026.
*   Urgently review the AML detection framework.
*   Address and update regulatory changes promptly.
